{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVdzeZs8AAAABbkGPpg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bpi2wzhFH-I8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bpi2w", "number": 13, "title": "Publish verified Animasa Miku GLB in GitHub Pages after redistribution rights are confirmed", "body": "## Goal

Make the **actual Animasa Hatsune Miku** available in the public `three-motionbricks` demo **without bundling or redistributing the Miku model** only until independently verifiable rights allow shipping it.

This is a **follow-up to #11 / PR #12**. Issue #11 is the working **local-only** Animasa conversion, upload, MotionBricks retargeting and physics integration. **This issue alone** tracks the additional deliverable of having Animasa automatically available when the public GitHub Pages demo loads, without requiring users to supply a locally converted GLB.

## Rights and delivery prerequisite

The original Three.js MMD example contains the verified `miku_v2.pmd` asset and `eyeM2.bmp` texture, but public-example usage by itself does not demonstrate a license for redistributing a newly converted GLB. Copyright/license rights in `takahirox/mmd-gltf` conversion code are distinct from those of the original character assets.

- [ ] Obtain and record the applicable complete original Animasa/PMD author/distributor terms or explicit rights-holder authorization for **conversion, derivative GLB distribution, reuse of the eye texture and other assets, and public GitHub repository / GitHub Pages hosting**, including notices, restrictions and Crypton/Piapro obligations.
- [ ] If any required rights remain unclear, **do not bundle, upload, fetch automatically, or publish the derivative**. Document the precise remaining requirement. Leave the local-only picker of #11 intact. Do not substitute Uka or imply that a different character completes this request.
- [ ] Keep a verifiable rights/provenance trail (source URLs, revision/hash, corresponding notice text, scope and date of permission). Attribution by itself does not confer redistribution rights.

## Implementation when authorization is established

- [ ] Reuse the exact, pinned Animasa `miku_v2.pmd`/texture sources and the tested offline PMD → skinned GLB conversion pipeline introduced by #11; preserve MMD-specific glTF toon/outline/solver/physics metadata.
- [ ] Configure an authorized, stable public asset delivery strategy (properly licensed, reliable repository/Pages asset or separately permissioned host with correct CORS). Avoid leaking unreviewed files into the Pages bundle.
- [ ] Enable normal **MMD (Animasa Miku)** selection without requiring local file upload; preserve optional local override if beneficial.
- [ ] Confirm MotionBricks-generated walk/run/turn/stop, SOMA→Animasa retargeting, visible hair/skirt MMD rigid-body physics, IK behavior, character switching and error recovery on the actual public origin.
- [ ] Update GitHub Actions/Pages asset allowlist, README, model credits and redistribution notices, plus production browser checks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The public URL [three-motionbricks](https://takahirox.github.io/three-motionbricks/) offers **the actual verified Animasa Miku**, automatically loads its legitimately distributed converted GLB, and needs no user-supplied file.
- [ ] The source rights/permission and required attribution/restrictions are documented and verifiable; no prohibited asset redistribution.
- [ ] Online WebGPU MotionBricks locomotion and MMD secondary physics work with the exact model, and other character modes continue to function.
- [ ] Build, tests, GitHub Pages deployment and published-origin smoke pass.

## References

- Local-only implementation: #11 and PR #12
- [Verified model source at Three.js r87](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r87/examples/models/mmd/miku/miku_v2.pmd)
- [Historical MMD asset terms](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r87/examples/models/mmd/Readme.txt)
- [Existing investigation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/mmd.md)
